caption: Figure 6.4 T.S. of stem :  (a) Dicot  (b) Monocot
note: Four drawings in two labelled panels. Panel (a), whole-section drawing at left: Epidermal hair, Epidermis, Hypodermis, Parenchyma, Endodermis, Pericycle, Vascular bundle, Medullary rays, Pith; panel (a) enlarged sector at right: Epidermis, Collenchyma, Parenchyma, Endodermis, Pericycle, Phloem, Cambium, Metaxylem, Protoxylem, Pith. Panel (b), whole-section drawing at left: Epidermis, Hypodermis, Vascular bundles, Ground tissue; panel (b) enlarged sector at right: Epidermis, Hypodermis, Vascular bundles, Phloem, Xylem, Ground tissue. Panel (b)'s labels are set in bold, panel (a)'s are not. Caption fully inside the frame; a clipped body-text line at the top ('grains and the layer is also referred to as the starch sheath. Pericycle is') belongs to the preceding paragraph.
